belier_belier.text: Two Aries (two Fire signs ruled by Mars) form an extremely passionate duo. Their relationship is very "passionate and explosive," full of energy and spontaneity. They live their love intensely, but their impulsiveness and matching egos frequently cause conflicts. Their union is exciting, but they must learn to calm their impulses for the relationship to last.

belier_taureau.text: Aries (Cardinal Fire) and Taurus (Fixed Earth) have opposite temperaments. Aries is impulsive and rushed (ruled by Mars), while Taurus is stable and patient (ruled by Venus). This elemental difference (Fire vs. Earth) leads to daily friction: Taurus may find Aries reckless, and Aries judges Taurus as too slow. Their attraction stems from this complementarity (energy vs. stability), but their harmony requires major compromises and mutual understanding.

belier_gemeaux.text: Aries (Fire) and Gemini (Air) form a very lively and dynamic couple. Both share a thirst for freedom and adventure. Aries acts with passion, and the curious, adaptable Gemini constantly stimulates Aries with their quick wit. Their relationship is full of shared projects: Aries brings the drive to act, and Gemini brings fresh ideas. They avoid routine and understand each other well, though they must be careful to temper Aries' impulsiveness against Gemini's occasional indecision.

belier_cancer.text: Aries (Fire) and Cancer (Water) struggle to harmonize. Their compatibility is low because they don't share the same element. Cancer looks toward the future and emotional security, while Aries lives in the moment. Cancer may feel ignored by the impetuous Aries, and Aries might get annoyed by Cancer's sensitivity. Their relationship can be deep if true love unites them, but they must accept major compromises: Cancer teaches Aries to consider feelings, and Aries teaches Cancer to trust the impulse of the present.

belier_lion.text: Aries (Fire) and Leo (Fire) share a strong elemental affinity. Their union is very intense and passionate. Both are proud and energetic: Aries and Leo create a relationship full of power and fervor. They stimulate each other and never lack excitement, but they can become competitive (both want to shine). If each respects the other's pride, their couple is very strong and physical.

belier_vierge.text: Aries (Fire) and Virgo (Earth) do not have the same pace of life. Virgo thinks long and hard before acting, while Aries charges headfirst. Aries dislikes the rules and rigor that Virgo imposes, creating conflict. Conversely, Virgo admires Aries' boldness but is irritated by their recklessness. Their relationship is therefore tense: the lack of elemental affinity (Fire vs. Earth) complicates compatibility. To work, they must greatly adapt to one another.

belier_balance.text: Aries (Fire) and Libra (Air) are opposites in the zodiac, creating a very strong complementarity. The calm, diplomatic Libra tempers Aries' impulsiveness, and the passionate Aries warms Libra's heart. It's a "perfect" combination in love: Libra brings harmony and control to Aries, who in turn brings energy and frankness. Together, they unite their differences to form a solid balance.

belier_scorpion.text: Aries (Fire) and Scorpio (Water) form a very intense and complex relationship. Scorpio (Fixed, ruled by Mars/Pluto) is enigmatic and passionate, while Aries (Cardinal Fire) is direct and energetic. Their couple can experience unbridled passion: Scorpio feeds Aries' strength, and Aries energizes Scorpio. But they have contradictory impulses (Scorpio likes to test, Aries likes to charge) that can lead to dangerous conflicts. They might experience the "ultimate love of their lives" or suffer violent arguments if neither channels their intensity.

belier_sagittaire.text: Aries (Fire) and Sagittarius (Fire) share great affinity. The optimistic and calm Sagittarius encourages Aries to think before acting. Together, they create a sweet and dynamic relationship. Both are drawn to adventure: the more patient Sagittarius is, the more Aries opens up to their advice, filling their life together with travel and discovery. They teach each other the taste for combat and adventure, making their couple very close.

belier_capricorne.text: Aries (Fire) and Capricorn (Earth) are two opposing cardinal signs. The cold, composed Capricorn acts like a "wall of ice" against Aries' ardor. Aries brings enthusiasm; Capricorn brings stability. They can build a balanced long-term relationship (they share ambition and willpower), but their association requires effort: Aries teaches Capricorn patience and a sense of the future, while Capricorn teaches Aries to think before charging. Their union is solid, occasionally punctuated by intense passions.

belier_verseau.text: Aries (Fire) and Aquarius (Air) get along very well thanks to their shared need for freedom. They both respect each other's independence and communicate harmoniously. Their relationship isn't weighed down by excessive demands: they understand each other's dreams and visions. The more detached Aquarius balances the more passionate Aries. It's one of the happiest couples in the zodiac, even if they must be careful not to hurt each other (e.g., differences over intimacy).

belier_poissons.text: Aries (Fire) and Pisces (Water) form a deeply emotional combination. Together, they can experience great passion and mutual devotion. Aries, usually aggressive, is softened by the devotion of Pisces, who invests themselves completely. They can create an intense chemistry: Pisces comforts Aries, who in turn brings liveliness. However, since their elements are opposite (Fire vs. Water), the relationship requires a lot of understanding: without true love, their differences (Aries' haste vs. Pisces' daydreaming) can cause tension.

taureau_belier.text: Taurus (Earth, Venus) and Aries (Fire, Mars) have highly contrasting temperaments. Taurus loves stability and simple pleasures; Aries seeks immediate action. This elemental opposition creates daily friction: Taurus feels rushed by Aries' impulsiveness, and Aries feels stifled by Taurus' leisurely pace. However, they can find balance: Aries is seduced by Taurus' constancy, and Taurus by Aries' fire. Their relationship relies heavily on compromise and mutual respect.

taureau_taureau.text: Two Tauruses together (Fixed Earth, ruled by Venus) share great affinity. They both love material comfort, gentleness, and loyalty. The Taurus-Taurus couple builds a solid home: each understands the other's needs (financial security, physical affection, stability). Their mutual stubbornness can cause some conflicts, but their patience often makes up for this refusal to yield. Ultimately, they find comfort in each other, forming a very stable and lasting bond.

taureau_gemeaux.text: Taurus (Earth) and Gemini (Air) have opposing needs. Taurus is fixated on security and routine; Gemini seeks diversity and movement. Their compatibility is low: their communication styles (pragmatic Taurus vs. chatty Gemini) differ radically. Taurus appreciates deep, reliable exchanges, while Gemini bounces between topics, which can irritate Taurus. They must be ready to understand each other despite these stark differences.

taureau_cancer.text: Taurus (Earth) and Cancer (Water) form a harmonious and solid couple. Their harmony is based on a shared goal of security and comfort. The pragmatic Taurus reassures the faithful Cancer, while the highly affectionate Cancer feels well-supported by Taurus. They build a warm home together. Only their difference in expressing emotions (Cancer needs reassuring words, Taurus prefers concrete actions) might require mutual adjustments.

taureau_lion.text: Taurus (Earth) and Leo (Fire) often have opposing values. The grounded Taurus loves tranquility and security; the flamboyant Leo seeks admiration and luxury. Initially, a strong attraction may exist (Taurus admires Leo's presence and vice versa), but their differences quickly surface. Taurus may feel jostled by Leo's exuberance, and Leo might judge Taurus as too modest. Their relationship requires major efforts to balance Taurus' stability with Leo's passion.

taureau_vierge.text: Taurus (Earth) and Virgo (Earth) are both highly pragmatic. Their elemental affinity ensures they understand each other perfectly. They share the same values: a sense of the concrete, loyalty, and a sense of responsibility. Taurus brings comfort and constancy to Virgo, while Virgo brings rigor and attention to detail to Taurus. Together, they form a very harmonious couple, living in stability and foresight.

taureau_balance.text: Taurus (Earth) and Libra (Air) are both ruled by Venus but differ greatly. Taurus seeks material and emotional security; Libra seeks relational balance and aesthetic pleasures. They can bond over a shared sense of elegance and stable relationships, but Taurus often finds Libra indecisive, and Libra judges Taurus as too materialistic. This combination requires patience: Libra brings gentleness, Taurus brings loyalty, but they must work to reconcile Earth and Air.

taureau_scorpion.text: Taurus (Earth) and Scorpio (Water) are opposites in the zodiac, generating a strong magnetic attraction. The stable Taurus is seduced by Scorpio's emotional depth, and Scorpio is drawn to Taurus' reliability. Together, they form a powerful balance: emotional security for Scorpio, shared passion for Taurus. Their relationship is marked by mutual loyalty and commitment. Intimacy is intense (a shared taste for sensuality), but their respective stubbornness requires good listening skills to maintain harmony.

taureau_sagittaire.text: Taurus (Earth) and Sagittarius (Fire) have very little in common. The rigorous Taurus loves habits, while the adventurous Sagittarius constantly seeks new experiences. Their elements clash (Earth vs. Fire), making complicity difficult. Taurus may reproach Sagittarius for being unpredictable, and Sagittarius finds Taurus too conservative. Their relationship demands huge concessions or risks running out of steam quickly.

taureau_capricorne.text: Taurus (Earth) and Capricorn (Earth) share strong elemental compatibility. Both are hardworking, loyal, and pragmatic. Taurus appreciates the financial stability Capricorn aims for, and Capricorn admires Taurus' constancy. Together, they build a solid life: they plan the future (home, career) jointly. Their relationship is highly reliable thanks to this shared goal of material security.

taureau_verseau.text: Taurus (Earth) and Aquarius (Air) have highly divergent needs. Taurus seeks routine and security; Aquarius loves the unconventional and independence. These fundamental differences complicate their harmony: Taurus may find Aquarius distant, and Aquarius may find Taurus possessive. Their relationship requires significant compromise to work.

taureau_poissons.text: Taurus (Earth) and Pisces (Water) complement each other well. The solid Taurus reassures the sensitive Pisces, who in turn brings poetry and tenderness to Taurus. They share a deep love for comfort and gentleness: the relationship is often very affectionate. Taurus stabilizes Pisces' dreams, and Pisces expands Taurus' imagination. Together, they can build a highly harmonious emotional cocoon.

gemeaux_belier.text: Gemini (Air) and Aries (Fire) form a highly dynamic tandem. Gemini is quick and adaptable; Aries is impulsive and courageous. Together, they turn daily life into an adventure: Aries pushes Gemini to take action, and Gemini stimulates Aries with new ideas. They share enthusiasm and avoid boredom. Their relationship is lively and passionate, though Aries must sometimes tone down their bluntness so as not to hurt Gemini.

gemeaux_taureau.text: Gemini (Air) and Taurus (Earth) have opposing needs. Gemini loves change and communication; Taurus seeks stability and tangible pleasures. Their compatibility is low: Taurus may find Gemini superficial, and Gemini judges Taurus as too routine-bound. Without major efforts to respect their differences, their relationship lacks depth and complicity.

gemeaux_gemeaux.text: Two Geminis together share many common traits. As Mutable Air signs, they love to discuss, exchange ideas, and live new experiences. Their compatibility is high because they understand each other's thirst for freedom and novelty. They energize their couple with humor and creativity. Warning: they must make sure to ground themselves occasionally to prevent the relationship from becoming too superficial.

gemeaux_cancer.text: Gemini (Air) and Cancer (Water) struggle to understand each other. Cancer dreams of emotional security, while Gemini seeks intellectual diversity. Gemini may seem too detached to Cancer, who may in turn find Gemini unreliable. Their relationship relies on effort: Gemini must be patient with Cancer's sensitivity, and Cancer must accept Gemini's need for independence.

gemeaux_lion.text: Gemini (Air) and Leo (Fire) form a fun and stimulating couple. The charismatic Leo appreciates Gemini's intellectual quickness, and Gemini enjoys Leo's warmth and generosity. Both love social life, sharing optimism and a drive to act. Their relationship is full of good humor and shared adventures, even if Leo must sometimes accept Gemini's inconsistent nature.

gemeaux_vierge.text: Gemini (Air) and Virgo (Earth) are opposed on the mutable axis. Although they share the planet Mercury, their approaches differ. Gemini loves versatility and lightness; Virgo loves order and meticulousness. Their compatibility is low: Gemini may judge Virgo as too strict, and Virgo finds Gemini too scattered. The relationship requires each to respect the other's analytical rhythm.

gemeaux_balance.text: Gemini (Air) and Libra (Air) share the same element. Both love to talk, exchange ideas, and be surrounded by people. The diplomatic Libra brings balance to Gemini's thoughts, who in turn enriches Libra with their imagination. Their relationship is very harmonious: they understand each other almost instinctively, and their intellectual complicity is strong.

gemeaux_scorpion.text: Gemini (Air) and Scorpio (Water) have little natural affinity. The intense and secretive Scorpio can baffle the sociable, open Gemini. Gemini's curiosity might not be enough to pierce Scorpio's mysteries. Their relationship requires significant communication efforts: Gemini must accept Scorpio's emotional depth, and Scorpio must accept Gemini's shifting lightness.

gemeaux_sagittaire.text: Gemini (Air) and Sagittarius (Fire) are opposing mutable signs, creating a natural attraction. Both share an enthusiasm for adventure and freedom. The intrepid Sagittarius excites Gemini's curious mind, and Gemini brings their versatility to Sagittarius. They experience their relationship as one grand intellectual and personal exploration.

gemeaux_capricorne.text: Gemini (Air) and Capricorn (Earth) have very different priorities. The serious, organized Capricorn may find Gemini too unpredictable, and Gemini may find Capricorn rigid. Their relationship lacks natural fluidity: they have few commonalities without compromise, and their compatibility is limited.

gemeaux_verseau.text: Gemini (Air) and Aquarius (Air) share strong elemental affinity. Both love communication, innovative ideas, and freedom. They stimulate each other intellectually and love discussing projects and concepts. Their relationship is very friendly and inventive: they form a dynamic tandem, eager for shared cultural or humanitarian projects.

gemeaux_poissons.text: Gemini (Air) and Pisces (Water) have a hard time meshing. The dreamy, introverted Pisces can feel overwhelmed by Gemini's energy, and Gemini may find Pisces too emotional. Their relationship requires a great effort of empathy: Gemini must listen to Pisces with more depth, and Pisces must accept Gemini's need for variety.

cancer_belier.text: Cancer (Water, Cardinal) and Aries (Fire, Cardinal) both seek to initiate things, but differently. The sensitive Cancer expects emotional security, while Aries charges ahead without looking. Their compatibility is low because their elements differ greatly. Cancer can feel hurt by Aries' impulsiveness, and Aries gets tired of Cancer's sensitivity. Their couple requires patience: Cancer must be more forgiving of Aries' impatience, and Aries must learn to handle Cancer's heart with care.

cancer_taureau.text: As seen previously, Taurus (Earth) and Cancer (Water) form a highly harmonious alliance. The emotional Cancer and pragmatic Taurus share the same goals: creating a stable, loving home. The protective Cancer finds a reliable partner in Taurus, and the loyal Taurus reassures Cancer through constancy. Their relationship is imbued with tenderness and emotional stability. Only their difference in expression (Cancer verbalizes emotions, Taurus shows love through actions) may require mutual adjustments.

cancer_gemeaux.text: Cancer (Water) and Gemini (Air) have little spontaneous affinity. Cancer seeks emotional security, while Gemini seeks lightness and diversity. Cancer may find Gemini too unstable; Gemini finds Cancer too needy. Their relationship relies on effort: Cancer must understand Gemini's need for space, and Gemini must understand Cancer's need for connection.

cancer_lion.text: Cancer (Water) and Leo (Fire) have very different temperaments. The introverted, protective Cancer can be overwhelmed by Leo's exuberance. Leo, who wants to be the center of attention, can threaten the emotional security Cancer seeks. Their relationship requires balance: Leo must soften their dominant nature, and Cancer must open up more to Leo's sociability, otherwise compatibility remains low.

cancer_vierge.text: Cancer (Water) and Virgo (Earth) form a warm, reliable couple. The empathetic Cancer finds an attentive, reliable ear in Virgo, and Virgo feels supported by Cancer's maternal side. They share a care for detail and sensitivity: Cancer reassures Virgo with affection, and Virgo relieves Cancer with practical help. Their relationship is solid, with each supporting the other in daily life.

cancer_balance.text: Cancer (Water) and Libra (Air) often struggle to connect. Libra seeks social harmony and may seem carefree to the Cancer, who craves emotional depth. Conversely, the passionate Cancer can be too intense for the balance-valuing Libra. Their compatibility is low: they must make great efforts to harmonize Cancer's sensitivity with Libra's lightness.

cancer_scorpion.text: Cancer (Water) and Scorpio (Water) share a very strong elemental affinity. Both deeply sensitive and loyal, they understand each other intuitively. The protective Cancer reassures the intense Scorpio, and the passionate Scorpio supports Cancer in return. Their relationship is emotionally charged and mutually committed. Together, they build deep intimacy marked by trust and mutual understanding.

cancer_sagittaire.text: Cancer (Water) and Sagittarius (Fire) have opposing expectations. Cancer seeks to settle down and protect themselves emotionally, while Sagittarius wants to constantly explore and move. Their relationship is difficult because their priorities differ: Cancer may feel neglected, and Sagittarius stifled. They can learn from each other (Sagittarius to nurture the home, Cancer to look at the bigger picture), but baseline compatibility remains low.

cancer_capricorne.text: Cancer (Water) and Capricorn (Earth) are opposites, creating a highly powerful bond. The emotionally giving Cancer finds material security in Capricorn, and the ambitious Capricorn finds a protective home in Cancer. They share long-term values (family, stability) and are both highly loyal. By communicating, they balance emotion and organization, making their relationship a very solid alliance.

cancer_verseau.text: Cancer (Water) and Aquarius (Air) have very different ways of seeing the world. The innovative, distant Aquarius can seem cold to the emotional Cancer. Their relationship lacks common ground: Cancer wants to attach; Aquarius prioritizes freedom. Without colossal efforts to understand each other, they risk lacking an emotional connection.

cancer_poissons.text: Cancer (Water) and Pisces (Water) get along very well. Both Water signs share deep empathy and gentleness. The securing, maternal Cancer brings support and comfort to Pisces, and the imaginative, altruistic Pisces brings romance and devotion to Cancer. Their relationship is very tender: they mutually nourish their dreams and loyalty, forming a close-knit, protective couple.

lion_belier.text: Leo (Fire) and Aries (Fire) have a natural complicity. Their relationship is passionate and courageous, with each encouraging the other to shine. They share enthusiasm and strong leadership skills. Together, they live exhilarating adventures. They must manage their shared egos (both want the lead role), but overall their union is highly lively and intense.

lion_taureau.text: Leo (Fire) and Taurus (Earth) differ on many points. The flamboyant Leo wants admiration and action, while Taurus anchors themselves in tranquility and comfort. A strong initial attraction may occur, but their divergences quickly appear. Taurus may judge Leo as too extravagant, and Leo may find Taurus too conservative. This relationship requires major compromises.

lion_gemeaux.text: Leo (Fire) and Gemini (Air) share a love for social life and novelty. The sociable, generous Leo appreciates Gemini's charm, and Gemini is seduced by Leo's confidence. Their relationship is fun and stimulating: they exchange a lot and share many interests. They form a vivacious, creative couple, provided they respect the other's need to sometimes take the floor or show off.

lion_cancer.text: Leo (Fire) and Cancer (Water) struggle to find common ground. The shy, protective Cancer can be crushed by Leo's constant need for admiration. The extroverted Leo can stress out Cancer. For their relationship to work, Leo must show more gentleness toward Cancer, and Cancer must feel free to express their emotions without holding back.

lion_vierge.text: Leo (Fire) and Virgo (Earth) may experience difficulties. The discreet, perfectionist Virgo may judge Leo as too dramatic, and Leo may find Virgo too critical. Their opposing ways of functioning (exuberance vs. modesty) require major adjustments: Virgo must accept Leo's expansive nature, and Leo must accept Virgo's rigor, otherwise compatibility remains average.

lion_balance.text: Leo (Fire) and Libra (Air) often form a harmonious couple. The balanced, sociable Libra appreciates Leo's generosity and charisma. Leo, in turn, admires Libra's kindness and elegance. They both love beautiful things and life as a couple. Their relationship is balanced: Leo brings warmth and passion, Libra brings listening skills and diplomacy, resulting in beautiful romantic harmony.

lion_scorpion.text: Leo (Fire) and Scorpio (Water) are vastly opposed. The frank, dominant Leo can clash with Scorpio's jealousy and depth. The intense Scorpio may find Leo too superficial. Their relationship requires heavy compromises: Leo must show more understanding, and Scorpio more lightness, for the love to endure.

lion_sagittaire.text: Leo (Fire) and Sagittarius (Fire) share great affinity. Both passionate and enthusiastic, they share a joy for life and a love for adventure. They motivate each other: Leo brings flair to Sagittarius' life, and Sagittarius brings optimism and new experiences to Leo. Their complicity is strong, as they value friendship just as much as romance in their couple.

lion_capricorne.text: Leo (Fire) and Capricorn (Earth) have little in common. The ambitious, reserved Capricorn can irritate the extroverted, theatrical Leo. Leo, who wants demonstrations of love, may find Capricorn too distant. Their relationship demands a lot of adaptation: they must learn to respect mutual needs (recognition for Leo, stability for Capricorn).

lion_verseau.text: Leo (Fire) and Aquarius (Air) are opposing signs, which often creates a strong attraction. The independent Aquarius admires Leo's strength and generosity, and Leo is intrigued by Aquarius' originality. Together, they can lead major social or creative projects. Their complementarity is based on mutual respect for freedom: Aquarius supports Leo without being possessive, and Leo encourages Aquarius' independent ideas.

lion_poissons.text: Leo (Fire) and Pisces (Water) have very different approaches to love. The flamboyant Leo can overwhelm the sensitive Pisces. Pisces, meanwhile, may seem too impressionable or distant to Leo. For this relationship to work, Leo must adopt more gentleness, and Pisces more assertiveness. Without these adjustments, compatibility remains limited.

vierge_belier.text: Virgo (Earth) and Aries (Fire) do not share the same element. The methodical, cautious Virgo finds Aries too blunt, and Aries judges Virgo as too critical. They have opposing ways of making decisions, demanding tolerance. Their relationship can work if each learns to benefit from the other's qualities: Virgo tempers Aries' impulsiveness, and Aries helps Virgo to be more daring.

vierge_taureau.text: Virgo (Earth) and Taurus (Earth) have extremely high compatibility. Their grounded, realistic nature unites them. Both seek security and comfort. The diligent Virgo brings rigor to Taurus' life, and Taurus supports Virgo with loyalty and gentleness. They share common practical values, making them highly harmonious.

vierge_gemeaux.text: Virgo (Earth) and Gemini (Air) are opposed on the mutable axis. Virgo seeks order and precision, while Gemini loves change and diversity. Their relationship lacks common elements: Gemini may find Virgo too nitpicky, and Virgo finds Gemini too scattered. They must work hard to find common ground or risk remaining distant.

vierge_cancer.text: Virgo (Earth) and Cancer (Water) form a highly complementary duo. The empathetic Cancer finds a reliable, attentive ear in Virgo, and Virgo feels supported by Cancer's maternal side. They share a need to care for others: Virgo organizes practical details, Cancer brings emotional warmth. Together, they build a stable home and love planning life together, making it a solid pairing.

vierge_lion.text: Virgo (Earth) and Leo (Fire) are very different. The discreet Virgo can be baffled by Leo's need to openly express emotions, and Leo may judge Virgo as too rational. Their relationship demands concessions: Leo must temper their exuberance to avoid frightening Virgo, and Virgo must react with more spontaneity toward Leo.

vierge_vierge.text: Two Virgos naturally understand each other. They share a sense of organization and a critical mind (which they try to use positively). Their couple is highly structured and reliable. They love planning their shared future and work hard to build it. The only risk: their mutual tendency to analyze can push them to criticize one another. However, their mutual aid and devotion make their relationship very stable.

vierge_balance.text: Virgo (Earth) and Libra (Air) don't operate the same way. Libra seeks harmony and aesthetics, while Virgo seeks precision and efficiency. Their areas of interest rarely overlap. Libra may find Virgo too fussy, and Virgo finds Libra too superficial. They will have to make an effort to complement each other: Virgo can help Libra actualize ideals, and Libra can soften Virgo's rigor.

vierge_scorpion.text: Virgo (Earth) and Scorpio (Water) get along very well. The passionate Scorpio finds a reliable partner in Virgo, and Virgo appreciates Scorpio's depth. Their relationship is based on commitment: neither enters the game casually. Scorpio brings emotional intensity to Virgo, and Virgo brings pragmatism and method to Scorpio. Together, they form a loyal, persevering couple.

vierge_sagittaire.text: Virgo (Earth) and Sagittarius (Fire) have little in common. The adventurous, optimistic Sagittarius can frustrate the cautious, pragmatic Virgo, and vice versa. Their relationship is generally difficult because Sagittarius wants to take risks, whereas Virgo prefers security. To work, they must make huge compromises: Sagittarius can learn to measure impulses, and Virgo to show more enthusiasm.

vierge_capricorne.text: Virgo (Earth) and Capricorn (Earth) have very strong compatibility. They share ambition and a sense of duty. Virgo supports Capricorn in achieving their projects by managing details, and Capricorn values Virgo for their reliability. Their relationship is serious and pragmatic: together, they patiently build their future, ensuring beautiful harmony.

vierge_verseau.text: Virgo (Earth) and Aquarius (Air) are hard to match. The original, independent Aquarius can clash with Virgo's structured, traditional nature. They have few common interests. Their elements don't mix, making compatibility very low without fundamental change.

vierge_poissons.text: Virgo (Earth) and Pisces (Water) are opposites, but this polarity creates beautiful complementarity. The dreamy, sensitive Pisces softens Virgo's daily life, who in return offers Pisces solid, concrete support. They share immense mutual respect. Pisces brings imagination to Virgo's plans, and Virgo helps Pisces organize their dreams. Their union can be highly harmonious if each values the other.

balance_belier.text: Libra (Air) and Aries (Fire) are opposites, producing a unique chemistry. The balanced Libra tempers Aries' impetuousness, and Aries awakens Libra to action. Together, they balance their differences: Aries brings passion and frankness, Libra brings diplomacy and romance. It's a dynamic relationship where each values the other's qualities.

balance_taureau.text: Libra (Air) and Taurus (Earth) share the planet Venus but differ on the essentials. The sociable, aesthetic Libra loves discussion; Taurus loves quiet and concrete pleasures. They might agree on a shared taste for comfort, but Taurus may find Libra too indecisive, and Libra finds Taurus too possessive. Compatibility depends on their ability to reconcile intellectual harmony with material stability.

balance_gemeaux.text: Libra (Air) and Gemini (Air) share the same element. Both are outwardly focused and love to communicate. Libra brings diplomacy and a sense of justice to the curious Gemini, and Gemini enriches Libra with their quick mind. Their relationship is light, cultured, and very harmonious as they both value conversation and social harmony.

balance_cancer.text: Libra (Air) and Cancer (Water) often struggle to find balance. The highly emotional Cancer may find Libra too superficial or distant, while Libra may judge Cancer as too possessive or moody. Their expectations differ: Cancer seeks a warm, deep home; Libra seeks harmony and intellectual sharing. They must work on mutual understanding for the relationship to function.

balance_lion.text: Libra (Air) and Leo (Fire) can get along incredibly well. The peaceful Libra softens the impulsive Leo, while the royal Leo brings passion and recognition to Libra. They both love being surrounded by people and enjoying life. Their relationship is often beautiful and creative, with Libra admiring Leo's charisma and Leo charmed by Libra's elegance.

balance_vierge.text: Libra (Air) and Virgo (Earth) have opposing ways of thinking. Libra seeks lightness and beauty; Virgo seeks precision and efficiency. Their values differ: Libra may find Virgo too nitpicky and reserved, and Virgo finds Libra too indecisive. They must respect these differences: Libra teaches Virgo not to take themselves too seriously, and Virgo teaches Libra how to actualize ideas.

balance_scorpion.text: Libra (Air) and Scorpio (Water) are very different emotionally. The intense, jealous Scorpio can make Libra uncomfortable, and Libra can seem superficial to the passionate Scorpio. Their relationship involves compromises: Libra must accept Scorpio's depth, and Scorpio must show more social flexibility for balance to exist.

balance_sagittaire.text: Libra (Air) and Sagittarius (Fire) generally have a good understanding. The harmonious Libra appreciates Sagittarius' optimism, and Sagittarius is drawn to Libra's charm and diplomacy. Both love intellectual journeys: they gladly discuss philosophies and new projects together. Their relationship is generally positive and balanced, though each must sometimes make concessions for Sagittarius' blunt honesty.

balance_capricorne.text: Libra (Air) and Capricorn (Earth) have very different interests. The ambitious, realistic Capricorn can seem too austere to Libra, who prefers ideals and beauty. Their vision of life diverges: Libra seeks fairness in the immediate, while Capricorn plans for the long term. Their compatibility is limited without major compromises.

balance_verseau.text: Libra (Air) and Aquarius (Air) share strong elemental affinity. Both are free-spirited and open to the world. They love discussing new ideas and acting for causes close to their hearts. Their relationship is very fluid and intellectual: they stimulate each other and maintain great harmony thanks to their shared progressive vision and sense of justice.

balance_poissons.text: Libra (Air) and Pisces (Water) have different emotional expectations. The balanced Libra may struggle to understand Pisces' highly emotional nature. The dreamy Pisces may judge Libra as too rational or hesitant. Their relationship works if both compromise: Libra must show more empathy, and Pisces must learn to communicate needs more explicitly.

scorpion_belier.text: Scorpio (Water) and Aries (Fire) form a highly intense relationship. Scorpio is passionate and deeply attracted to Aries' strength, and the courageous Aries is fascinated by the mysterious Scorpio. Their couple life is a matter of strong temperaments: they will experience moments of overflowing passion. However, this mutual intensity can also degenerate into rivalries (both want to dominate). They can have a great love story if each learns to temper their impulses.

scorpion_taureau.text: Scorpio (Water) and Taurus (Earth) are zodiac opposites, creating very strong attraction. The intense Scorpio is drawn to Taurus' stability, and Taurus is seduced by Scorpio's depth. Their couple is balanced: Taurus secures Scorpio, and Scorpio makes Taurus more expressive. They share values of loyalty and commitment. Their intimacy is passionate, and together they can build a solid relationship if they respect each other.

scorpion_gemeaux.text: Scorpio (Water) and Gemini (Air) have little in common. The dark, jealous Scorpio can unsettle a Gemini who is looking for lightness. Talkative and changeable, Gemini can seem far too superficial to Scorpio. Compatibility stays low without a great deal of mutual understanding. They will have to make the effort to truly discover one another: Gemini must accept Scorpio's complexity, and Scorpio must learn to take things less heavily.

scorpion_cancer.text: Scorpio (Water) and Cancer (Water) share a very strong natural affinity. The two Water signs understand each other deeply and communicate without words. Scorpio is drawn to Cancer's loyalty and gentleness, and Cancer is reassured by Scorpio's protective strength. Their relationship is very intimate and emotional: they support each other through hardships, building a lasting connection.

scorpion_lion.text: Scorpio (Water) and Leo (Fire) are very different. The flamboyant, extroverted Leo can dominate the sensitive Scorpio. Scorpio, in return, may find Leo too superficial and selfish. Their relationship demands tolerance: Leo must leave more emotional space for Scorpio, and Scorpio must show more warmth toward Leo.

scorpion_vierge.text: Scorpio (Water) and Virgo (Earth) get along very well. The discreet, loyal Virgo offers Scorpio reliable support, and Scorpio brings passion and intensity to Virgo's life. Their union is serious and deep: both value loyalty and commitment. They work hand-in-hand toward shared goals, making the relationship durable and solid.

scorpion_balance.text: Scorpio (Water) and Libra (Air) are hardly compatible. The peaceful, superficial (in their eyes) Libra can clash with Scorpio's emotional depth. Scorpio may find Libra too hesitant. Their relationship imposes many concessions: Libra must accept going beyond appearances, and Scorpio must learn to trust more quickly.

scorpion_scorpion.text: Two Scorpios together live an extremely intense relationship. They understand each other naturally and share the same passions and mysteries. Their closeness runs deep, because neither hesitates to dive into the other's emotions. However, their mutual jealousy and stubbornness can create fierce conflicts. If they manage to talk openly and show tolerance, the bond can be exceptionally strong, but they must avoid being swallowed by suspicion and rivalry.

scorpion_sagittaire.text: Scorpio (Water) and Sagittarius (Fire) operate differently. Scorpio seeks emotional intensity and commitment, while Sagittarius wants freedom and adventure. Without concessions the relationship is difficult: Sagittarius may find Scorpio too possessive, and Scorpio may find Sagittarius too carefree. They will need to talk a great deal to find middle ground between Scorpio's depth and Sagittarius's lightness.

scorpion_capricorne.text: Scorpio (Water) and Capricorn (Earth) can build a solid couple. Passionate Scorpio and ambitious Capricorn share a sense of effort and discipline. Capricorn brings Scorpio structure and practical sense, and Scorpio gives Capricorn emotional support and intensity. Both value loyalty and serious planning for the future. Their relationship is earnest and lasting, with strong closeness whenever the balance holds.

scorpion_verseau.text: Scorpio (Water) and Aquarius (Air) have opposing visions. The progressive, distant Aquarius can seem incomprehensible to the intense, emotional Scorpio. Their relationship lacks common ground. They must learn to listen and accept the other's world, or compatibility remains low.

scorpion_poissons.text: Scorpio (Water) and Pisces (Water) share a beautiful emotional closeness. Both Water signs grasp each other's feelings intuitively. Soothing and empathetic, Pisces gives Scorpio moral support, and Scorpio offers Pisces security and passion. Their relationship is deeply intimate: they can create an almost merging bond that unites Scorpio's depth with Pisces's gentleness.

sagittaire_belier.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Aries (Fire) are highly compatible as they share the same passion and energy. The optimistic Sagittarius and impulsive Aries stimulate each other. Sagittarius brings wisdom and reflection; Aries brings fighting spirit. Their couple is geared toward adventure: together, they explore the world and push each other to evolve.

sagittaire_taureau.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Taurus (Earth) have little in common. Sagittarius loves freedom and the unexpected; Taurus prefers routine and security. Their priorities diverge: Taurus may feel ignored by the flighty Sagittarius, and Sagittarius stifled by the possessive Taurus.

sagittaire_gemeaux.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Gemini (Air) often form an excellent duo. They share intellectual curiosity and a taste for adventure. The expansive Sagittarius and communicative Gemini stimulate each other's minds. Their relationship is based on freedom and discovery.

sagittaire_cancer.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Cancer (Water) have very different needs. Cancer seeks emotional security, while Sagittarius wants adventure. Their relationship is often conflictual: Cancer may judge Sagittarius as too carefree, and Sagittarius may find Cancer too homebound.

sagittaire_lion.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Leo (Fire) share a natural enthusiasm. Sociable Leo and optimistic Sagittarius have the same appetite for living fully. Both enjoy taking calculated risks and help each other reach their goals. Their couple is dynamic and very close: few conflicts, because they spur one another on and value the other's honesty.

sagittaire_vierge.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Virgo (Earth) differ on many levels. The adventurous, fiery Sagittarius can annoy the rational, cautious Virgo, and vice versa. Their life approaches are opposed: Virgo plans every detail; Sagittarius acts spontaneously.

sagittaire_capricorne.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Capricorn (Earth) have little natural compatibility. The serious Capricorn may judge Sagittarius as too thoughtless, and Sagittarius finds Capricorn too rigid. The relationship functions poorly without real commonalities, as one wants to build patiently while the other wants to travel. (Note: This combination was listed twice in the original text with similar rationale; this captures the essence of both).

sagittaire_balance.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Libra (Air) share a philosophical mind. Harmony-seeking Libra respects Sagittarius's optimism, and Sagittarius admires Libra's diplomacy. Together they enjoy discussing big plans and new ideas. Their relationship is generally positive and balanced: they stimulate each other intellectually, though concessions are sometimes needed around Sagittarius's blunt sincerity.

sagittaire_scorpion.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Scorpio (Water) have diverging needs. Sagittarius wants to explore outward and enjoy himself, Scorpio wants to plunge into intimacy and inner transformation. Their priorities make understanding difficult. They will have to learn to respect their emotional differences: Sagittarius by showing more depth, and Scorpio by loosening up in Sagittarius's optimism.

sagittaire_verseau.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Aquarius (Air) form a very close couple. Both look to the future and share a need for freedom. They love learning and stretching themselves together, especially through travel or cultural projects. Their connection is intellectual and optimistic: Sagittarius's spirit completes Aquarius's visionary ideas. Together they build a relationship founded on friendship and trust.

sagittaire_poissons.text: Sagittarius (Fire) and Pisces (Water) have little natural compatibility. The frank, extroverted Sagittarius can hurt the hypersensitive Pisces, and the overly dreamy Pisces can seem passive to Sagittarius. Their relationship demands major compromise efforts.

capricorne_belier.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Aries (Fire) can form an ambitious but clashing team. Patient Capricorn acts like a wall of ice against Aries's fire. Aries gives the couple momentum, Capricorn gives it structure. Together they share ambition, from work to success, and can build something solid. They must learn from each other: Aries to plan, Capricorn to seize the moment. The relationship is stable once those compromises are found.

capricorne_taureau.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Taurus (Earth) have very high compatibility. They share the same pragmatic values: hard work, stability, loyalty. Taurus supports Capricorn's ambition with steadiness, and Capricorn reassures Taurus with reliability. Together they organise life concretely, from finances to the home, and support one another. Their relationship is solid and built to last.

capricorne_gemeaux.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Gemini (Air) have little in common. Ambitious, disciplined Capricorn finds Gemini too superficial, and Gemini finds Capricorn too serious. The relationship lacks natural communication. They must work at reconciling Capricorn's seriousness with Gemini's lightness in order to find a balance.

capricorne_cancer.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Cancer (Water) form a highly complementary couple. The warm, protective Cancer reassures Capricorn and builds a loving home. The ambitious, stable Capricorn offers Cancer the security and structure they need. They project their energy into the same family and material goals.

capricorne_lion.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Leo (Fire) have opposing values. The career-driven Capricorn may judge Leo as too selfish or spendthrift. Leo, in turn, may find Capricorn too rigid. Their relationship requires massive adaptation to work.

capricorne_vierge.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Virgo (Earth) share the same pragmatic energy. The couple aims at effectiveness: meticulous Virgo supports Capricorn's projects with precision, and Capricorn values Virgo's reliability. Both have a sense of duty and organisation. Their relationship rests on mutual respect for work well done, which makes them highly compatible.

capricorne_balance.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Libra (Air) struggle to find common ground. Hard-working Capricorn can seem dull to Libra, who wants more pleasure and harmony. Libra in turn may strike Capricorn as too casual. Without significant concessions the relationship risks lacking closeness.

capricorne_scorpion.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Scorpio (Water) can get on very well. Ambitious Capricorn brings Scorpio structure and practical sense, and Scorpio brings Capricorn emotional intensity and loyalty. Both are determined and serious about commitment. Together they form a powerful couple: Capricorn steadies Scorpio, Scorpio motivates Capricorn. Their relationship is strong on both the emotional and the practical level.

capricorne_sagittaire.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Sagittarius (Fire) have little in common. Realistic, cautious Capricorn can frustrate optimistic, carefree Sagittarius, and the reverse is just as true. Sagittarius lives in the moment, Capricorn plans the future. Their life goals diverge too much for real understanding without very substantial compromises.

capricorne_capricorne.text: Two Capricorns understand each other perfectly. They have the same ambitions and methods: work, organisation and discipline sit at the heart of the couple. They support each other in reaching long-term goals. Their relationship is very solid, even if it can lack spontaneity. They must remember to allow themselves moments of rest so life together stays balanced.

capricorne_verseau.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Aquarius (Air) have very low compatibility. Rebellious, collectively minded Aquarius can seem far too detached to ambitious, traditional Capricorn. Their priorities do not line up: Capricorn aims at security and status, Aquarius favours innovation and freedom. That gap makes the relationship difficult without enormous concessions.

capricorne_poissons.text: Capricorn (Earth) and Pisces (Water) complement each other well. Pragmatic Capricorn grounds Pisces's dreams, while Pisces brings Capricorn compassion and imagination. They share a deep sense of responsibility towards family and duty. Their relationship combines Capricorn's realism with Pisces's gentleness, forming a protective and balanced bond.

verseau_belier.text: Aquarius (Air) and Aries (Fire) form a very free and inventive couple. Both value independence and enjoy a challenge. Aries brings Aquarius enthusiasm, and Aquarius brings Aries originality. Their understanding rests on great mutual trust: each supports the other's wild ideas. They have fun together, widen their view of the world, and benefit from respecting their differences.

verseau_taureau.text: Aquarius (Air) and Taurus (Earth) have vastly different expectations. Aquarius loves social innovation and eccentricity, while Taurus seeks tradition and stability. Aquarius may find Taurus too conservative, and Taurus finds Aquarius too unpredictable.

verseau_gemeaux.text: Aquarius (Air) and Gemini (Air) share the same element, which strengthens their compatibility. Both signs are communicative and original. They have a large appetite for intellectual exchange: conversation, visionary ideas and forward-looking projects. Their relationship is built on friendship and mental stimulation. They understand each other perfectly and respect the other's freedom.

verseau_cancer.text: Aquarius (Air) and Cancer (Water) struggle to align. The independent, futuristic Aquarius can seem cold to the sensitive, home-oriented Cancer. Cancer seeks emotional security that the distant Aquarius struggles to provide consistently.

verseau_lion.text: Aquarius (Air) and Leo (Fire) are opposite signs, which often creates strong attraction. Independent Aquarius admires Leo's strength and generosity, and Leo is intrigued by Aquarius's originality. Together they can carry out ambitious creative or social projects. Their complementarity rests on mutual respect for freedom: Aquarius supports Leo without possessiveness, and Leo encourages Aquarius's independent ideas.

verseau_vierge.text: Aquarius (Air) and Virgo (Earth) are barely compatible. Idealistic Aquarius may find Virgo too down to earth, and Virgo may find Aquarius too unrealistic. They lack any obvious shared vision. Their relationship demands major adjustments before they can genuinely understand one another.

verseau_balance.text: Aquarius (Air) and Libra (Air) share great elemental affinity. Both are drawn to abstraction, friendship, and humanistic causes. They are visionary and love discussing philosophical concepts. Their relationship is intellectually highly balanced.

verseau_scorpion.text: Aquarius (Air) and Scorpio (Water) have very opposite natures. Independent and rational, Aquarius can seem indifferent to passionate, possessive Scorpio. They must make the effort to discover each other: Aquarius by listening to Scorpio's emotions, Scorpio by accepting Aquarius's distance. Without that effort, compatibility stays low.

verseau_sagittaire.text: Aquarius (Air) and Sagittarius (Fire) get on very well, because both love freedom and innovation. They share optimism and openness to the world. Their relationship is built on friendship: they encourage one another to try new experiences and to stand up for their ideals. Together they can carry out many projects, each contributing their own originality.

verseau_capricorne.text: Aquarius (Air) and Capricorn (Earth) are nearly incompatible. Ambitious, traditional Capricorn does not always understand eccentric, future-facing Aquarius. Aquarius, for his part, can find Capricorn too strict. Their relationship calls for a major compromise that is hard to reach.

verseau_poissons.text: Aquarius (Air) and Pisces (Water) work differently. Dreamy Pisces may find Aquarius too cerebral, and Aquarius may perceive Pisces as too emotional. Their understanding takes considerable effort: Aquarius must listen to Pisces's imagination, and Pisces must show more practicality in order to be understood.

poissons_belier.text: Pisces (Water) and Aries (Fire) create a surprising combination. Bold Aries and sensitive Pisces can experience a deep passion. Pisces leads Aries to explore his emotional side, and Aries encourages Pisces to take action. Their relationship is very intense on the intimate level. Still, the differences between a direct Aries and a dreamy Pisces call for understanding and balance: Pisces must voice her needs, and Aries must learn to listen.

poissons_taureau.text: Pisces (Water) and Taurus (Earth) complement each other well. Empathetic and imaginative, Pisces finds stability and comfort in Taurus. Grounded Taurus is moved by Pisces's gentleness and selflessness. They share a love of home and of sensory comfort. Their relationship is tender and reassuring: Taurus gives reality to Pisces's dreams, and Pisces gives poetry to Taurus's life.

poissons_gemeaux.text: Pisces (Water) and Gemini (Air) do not move at the same pace. Communicative Gemini can seem to lack depth in dreamy Pisces's eyes. Conversely, Pisces may feel too sensitive to pragmatic Gemini. Their relationship calls for adjustment: Gemini must listen with more sensitivity, and Pisces must accept a little lightness.

poissons_cancer.text: Pisces (Water) and Cancer (Water) form a very gentle and empathetic union. The two Water signs share the same sensitivity. Dreamy Pisces finds a protective partner in Cancer, and Cancer receives from Pisces the emotional understanding he longs for. Their relationship is deeply merging: they share the same ideal dream and sustain one another in affection.

poissons_lion.text: Pisces (Water) and Leo (Fire) have very divergent approaches. Dazzling Leo can overwhelm introverted Pisces. Overly sensitive Pisces can feel wounded by Leo's bluntness. For the relationship to work, Leo must show a great deal of gentleness and patience, and Pisces must learn to assert herself.

poissons_vierge.text: Pisces (Water) and Virgo (Earth) sit opposite each other, but that polarity creates a fine complementarity. Grounded Virgo organises Pisces's life, while Pisces brings Virgo inspiration and tenderness. They balance one another: Pisces helps Virgo grow more compassionate, and Virgo helps Pisces give shape to her dreams. Their relationship is marked by solidarity and devotion, each supplying what the other lacks.

poissons_balance.text: Pisces (Water) and Libra (Air) have different expectations. Romantic and emotional, Pisces may feel misunderstood by cerebral Libra. Pragmatic Libra may find Pisces too indecisive. Their relationship calls for concessions: they must learn to harmonise Pisces's imagination with Libra's reason.

poissons_scorpion.text: Pisces (Water) and Scorpio (Water) complement each other beautifully. They share a deep emotional understanding. Intense Scorpio protects Pisces's dream, and Pisces soothes Scorpio's force. Their closeness runs deep: both value loyalty and mutual surrender. Their relationship is rich in passion and tenderness, marked by the devotion of each.

poissons_sagittaire.text: Pisces (Water) and Sagittarius (Fire) are very different. Enthusiastic Sagittarius can seem short on sensitivity in Pisces's eyes, and Pisces can seem too yielding to Sagittarius. Their relationship demands work on understanding: Sagittarius must listen to Pisces's emotions, and Pisces must learn to follow Sagittarius's momentum.

poissons_capricorne.text: Pisces (Water) and Capricorn (Earth) get on well. Structured Capricorn provides Pisces with the solid base she is asking for, and Pisces brings Capricorn compassion and creativity. They form a balanced couple: Capricorn grounds Pisces's ideals, and Pisces softens Capricorn's austerity. Together they can achieve fine things by combining dream and realism.

poissons_verseau.text: Pisces (Water) and Aquarius (Air) struggle to understand each other. Independent and rational, Aquarius can seem unfeeling to Pisces, and Pisces too intuitive for Aquarius. Their relationship lacks common ground: Pisces dreams of a deep emotional bond, Aquarius values friendship and abstraction. Little natural compatibility without large compromises.

cancer_cancer.text: Two Cancers together form a very strong emotional cocoon. They share the same need for affective security, tenderness and home. Their common sensitivity makes them highly empathetic towards one another: they sense their partner's needs without needing them spelled out. Their relationship is gentle and protective. However, their shared emotionality can leave them exposed to simultaneous mood swings. If they learn not to retreat into their shells together, their union is deeply loving and durable.

lion_lion.text: Two Leos together create a dazzling, theatrical couple. They share the same passion, the same pride and the same need for recognition. Their relationship is intense and spectacular: they admire one another and live love with flair. However, their powerful egos can lead to power struggles, since each wants to be the king or queen of the couple. If they learn to share the spotlight and admire each other without competing, their union is magnificent and full of warmth.

balance_balance.text: Two Libras together form a very harmonious and aesthetic couple. They share the same love of balance, beauty and diplomacy. Their relationship is gentle and refined: they avoid conflict and always look for compromise. However, that permanent quest for harmony can stop them from facing real problems. Their shared indecision can also slow down important choices. If they overcome that tendency, their couple is one of the most pleasant and elegant in the zodiac.

sagittaire_sagittaire.text: Two Sagittarians together live a relationship full of adventure and optimism. They share the same thirst for freedom, travel and discovery. Their couple faces outward: they explore the world together with enthusiasm and good humour. However, their shared need for independence can pull them apart if they do not take the time to build real intimacy. If they find the balance between adventure and commitment, their relationship is joyful and stimulating.

verseau_verseau.text: Two Aquarians together form a highly original and intellectual couple. They share the same progressive view of the world, the same need for freedom and the same curiosity. Their relationship is built on friendship and on respect for each other's individuality. However, their shared tendency towards emotional detachment can create affective distance. If they learn to express feelings beyond the intellect, their union is unique, inventive and deeply respectful.

poissons_poissons.text: Two Pisces together create a highly emotional and intuitive relationship. They understand each other deeply and share a rich, sensitive inner world. Their couple is steeped in romance, creativity and mutual compassion. However, their extreme sensitivity can leave them vulnerable: without concrete grounding, they risk losing themselves together in dreams or feelings. If they find a balance between their inner world and reality, their union is magical and profoundly connected.
